Review this change for security vulnerabilities.

Changed files (you may Read these and any other file in the repo):
  - tests/experience.test.ts

Unified diff (only + lines are new):

=== DIFF: tests/experience.test.ts ===
@@ -144,11 +144,9 @@ test('both pages render the section at their experience marker', async () => {
     const page = await Bun.file(new URL(path, import.meta.url)).text()
     expect(page).toMatch(/import Experience from '[./]*components\/Experience\.astro'/)
     expect(page).toMatch(/<Experience lang=\{lang\} \/>/)
-    // The other four markers belong to the sections still in flight.
+    // Only this section's own marker is asserted. Pinning the siblings' markers here
+    // would encode a transient state: each one disappears as that section lands.
     expect(page).not.toContain('section-import: experience')
-    for (const marker of ['method', 'projects', 'stack', 'contact']) {
-      expect(page).toContain(`section-import: ${marker}`)
-      expect(page).toContain(`{/* section: ${marker} */}`)
-    }
+    expect(page).not.toContain('{/* section: experience */}')
   }
 })


Investigate per the method in your instructions, then return the findings list.

The diff only modifies a test file (`tests/experience.test.ts`). Per the review instructions, test/mock files are explicitly out of scope for security findings. The change tightens/loosens assertions about page markers — no entry point, no sink, no data flow to attacker-influenced input.
